quarterly_data.signal: Systems backlog, including deferred systems revenue, was $457.0 million as of December 31, 2025 versus $645.8 million as of December 31, 2024. Backlog includes only system orders with accepted purchase orders, and orders can be cancelled or rescheduled by customers with limited or no penalties.
Capital expenditures were $11.3 million in 2025 and $12.2 million in 2024; total capital expenditures for 2026 are projected to be approximately $18 million.
